items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: he and Harold Baquet Backey... and a girl by the name of Glenna Cheeseman... they took me out on the road with them

ctx.x: Do you remember his real name?

Right now I can't -- I probably will a little later on, I did know his name, but he and Harold Baquet Backey, which became a famous singer was on the show and a girl by the name of Glenna Cheeseman, that's about all I can remember from -- and it was a small revue and they took me out on the road with them --
